responsibility: Provides the master X-macro definition table that maps RISC-V ISA extension names to public runtime bitmask positions and groups used by GCC’s common RISC-V CPU feature interface. Ordered to match Linux hwprobe extension ordering, it serves as generated-data input for code that builds minimal feature masks or extension lookup structures, rather than implementing option parsing itself; its content is the canonical registry of extension-string to bit-position assignments for standard and Z*/V* subsets.
